lines: First you take {item_stack} from the chest, now you try and take it from me,
That was already confiscated once. Taking {item_stack} from my pack does not make it yours.
I put {item_stack} away because you took it from village stores. Do not make me say this twice.
You reached into the chest, then into my inventory. That is a pattern, not a mistake.
The village already had to take {item_stack} back from you. Leave it where I put it.
That item was stolen, so I am taking it back.
You cannot keep something that belongs to the village.
The owner needs this returned.
This is a warning before the guards get involved.
Do not reach for another stolen item.
I will give the property to the right person.
The village saw where you got it.
A second offense will not end this quietly.
You had a chance to return it yourself.
The item is evidence as well as property.
Step back while I secure it.
Taking it again will be treated as another theft.
No payment makes stolen goods yours.
The owner has been looking for this.
I am keeping the item out of your reach.
Again, First the chest, then my inventory, and now this. You are running out of warnings.
I already warned you about taking confiscated goods. Keep your hands off {item_stack}.
You are trying to steal the same kind of trouble twice. The next time, we stop talking.
That item was removed from you for a reason. Touch my inventory again and I will not ask politely.
You took from the village, then from me, and now you test whether I remember. I do.
I am returning this to its owner again.
You already ignored your chance to return it.
You tried to take village property twice.
The owner should not have to ask for this again.
This repeat theft is going straight to the guards.
Coin will not excuse taking the same goods twice.
The warning was the first time. Now the guards hear about it.
This is the second offense, and I am done warning you.
We kept this as evidence after the first theft.
I confiscated it once, and I am confiscating it again.
Back away. I will secure it somewhere you cannot reach.
The owner has been waiting while you tried this again.
I am moving it somewhere your hands cannot reach.
Do not touch confiscated property again.
The village saw you take it the first time and the second.
No more warnings. Chest, villager, chest again. You chose this over {item_stack}.
Three times is enough. The village is done asking for {item_stack} back.
You keep stealing what we already took back. Now you answer for {item_stack}.
First the chest, then my inventory, now {item_stack} again. No more words.
You had two chances to stop reaching for {item_stack}. You wasted both.
<dark_red><shake>No more warnings.</shake></dark_red> Put {item_stack} down.
The guards are coming. Drop {item_stack} and keep your hands where we can see them.
You stole it, lost it, then stole it again. This ends now.
That is the last time you touch {item_stack}.
We gave you chances. You answered by stealing from us again.
Return {item_stack} before someone gets hurt.
The whole village knows what you did with {item_stack}.
You will not walk away with our property again.
I warned you twice. Now the guards can deal with you.
Put {item_stack} on the ground and step back.
There is nowhere left to hide {item_stack}.
You chose the stolen goods over every warning we gave you.
That stack belongs here. You do not.
Enough. Hand over {item_stack}.
You had every chance to stop. Now it is too late.
Ow! Why would you do that?
Stop! That hurts!
Help! They hit me!
Why did you hit me?
Get away from me!
I am telling the grown-ups!
I did not do anything to you!
Leave me alone!
I want my family!
You are mean!
Do not touch me again!
I am going to the golem!
Somebody help me!
That really hurt!
I do not want to talk to you!
The grown-ups said to stay away from you.
I am scared of you now.
Why are you hurting children?
I am going home!
Stop following me!
Ow! Something hit me!
Help! That hurt!
I want to go home!
Someone got hurt and it scared me.
I stayed with the grown-ups until it was safe.
The bell was loud enough to make me cry.
I keep asking whether the hurt person is better.
I know which house to run to now.
The golem stood near us afterward.
I do not want to see another fight.
The village felt too quiet when the shouting stopped.
I slept close to my family that night.
Someone held my hand while the healer worked.
I remember more than the adults think I do.
We practiced what to do if danger returns.
I still jump when voices get loud.
I am glad the person survived.
Nobody should get hurt in the square.
I wanted to leave as soon as the fighting started.
The adults made us stay inside until it was over.
No, no, no! I saw what you did!
Help! They hurt them!
I want the grownups!
I saw you hurt them. Stay away from me.
You did it. I saw you hurt them until they died.
Do not come near me.
The grown-ups know what you did.
I am going where the golem can see me.
You made someone disappear from the village.
I will not listen to your excuses.
Everyone told the children to stay away from you.
I remember your face from that moment.
The bell rang because of you.
You are not safe to be around.
Do not follow me home.
The guards are already looking for you.
I saw who was there, and I will tell them.
You cannot make this better by acting friendly now.
Their family still cries because of you.
The golem will keep you away from us.
No, no, no! Run!
Where are the grown-ups?
Hide! Hide now!
I saw someone die and I cannot stop thinking about it.
The grown-ups keep saying I am safe now.
I still look for the person who is not coming back.
The bell sounded sad after it happened.
I do not want to walk near that place alone.
Everyone speaks more quietly around me.
I asked whether they knew we were there.
I left a flower where people were remembering them.
The village feels different without their footsteps.
I stay close to my family when it gets dark.
I wish dangerous things would leave us alone.
The grown-ups answer some questions and avoid others.
I drew what I remembered because words were hard.
I do not like hearing people say it was quick.
Their house still looks like they might open the door.
I ran home and locked the door behind me.
I still hear the shouting when I try to sleep.
